review: I pastored for twenty-two years and I have not been in a service since 2023 except at Christmas, in the back, and I leave before the last song. I listen in the car between insurance appointments and it is the closest thing I have had to prayer in two years, which I am aware is a sad sentence, and I am not going to dress it up.
